A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ResQ research work. The complete main texts and appendices, including equations, figures and tables, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantization evaluations on Llama models, generative-task results, ablations and GPU timing measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains original Llama experiments and adds Qwen2.5, vision-language MMMU, additional precision-setting and GPU timing results.

M1.justification: PCA-based subspace selection, within-subspace rotation, mixed-precision quantization, GPTQ integration and the four inference projections remain unchanged. The added model evaluations do not establish a new ResQ component or procedure; the executed multiplication in Equation 4 is retained.

E1.justification: v2 adds multimodal understanding evaluation on MMMU using Qwen2-VL, extending text-only coverage to image-and-text tasks across six subject groups (Table 3 and Appendix F). The original Wikitext, commonsense, MMLU, GSM8K and LongBench tasks remain.

E2.justification: The original Llama 4/4/4 and generative-task comparator sets remain. v2 adds an INT4 runtime control and extends existing quantization baselines into the broader 4/8/4 comparisons. Table 8 also specifies random orthogonal rotations for the starred QuaRot configurations where Hadamard matrices are unavailable.

E3.justification: v2 adds seven Qwen2.5 model sizes, Qwen2-VL configurations with 16-bit vision encoders, and extensive 4/8/4 evaluations. Hardware testing changes from A100 linear layers at sequence lengths 1024/8192 to RTX 3090 decoder blocks at 512/8192 with batch size 1. The existing 512-sample projection and 128-sample GPTQ calibration settings remain.

E4.justification: New Figure 3 separately illustrates activation distributions before projection, after PCA and after rotation, and the hardware comparison measures overhead against INT4. The projection-removal, rank and calibration-size ablations remain unchanged. The original appendix activation-distribution panels are retained as Figure 7.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or experimental error bars. The additional results do not introduce uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: v2 adds extensive Qwen2.5, MMMU and 4/8/4 results while retaining the original Llama task scores. For example, Qwen2-VL-7B MMMU accuracy at 4/4/4 is 47.0 for ResQ versus 28.9 for QUIK. Hardware speedups change from 1.25–2.4× to 1.61–3.03× under different measurement conditions, not as same-setting gains. New Table 9 reports 8.1 perplexity for Llama-3.2-3B at 4/8/4, whereas retained Table 4 reports 8.2 without explaining the difference.

T1.justification: Equations 2–3 remove v1's reconstruction factors and redefine the quantized operands in projected coordinates. The resulting expressions add unequal-sized groups while the original-space error formulas remain, introducing a local mathematical inconsistency. The Gaussian assumption, Theorem 4.2 and appendix proof are otherwise retained.

C1.justification: The central claims of training-free PCA-based mixed-precision quantization and optimality remain. The abstract and conclusion extend claimed effectiveness to Qwen models and multimodal understanding, and raise the headline speedup from 2.4× to approximately 3× using the revised hardware experiment.

C2.justification: v2 removes the technical limitations concerning unexplored calibration datasets, potentially suboptimal constant ranks and untested learned projection refinement; only the general societal-impact discussion remains. It also interprets the new MMMU results as evidence of generalizability and the INT4 comparison as demonstrating limited runtime overhead.

D1.justification: v2 documents the unquantized vision encoder, the QuaRot rotation fallback, additional runtime-testing details and Qwen model/license links. Existing calibration counts, evaluation-harness version, quantization timings and code-access information are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for Qwen2.5, Qwen2-VL, MMMU and QuIP#, with QuIP# replacing QuIP as the citation supporting Lemma 4.1. The related-work taxonomy and ResQ's central positioning remain stable; publication updates for existing references are not new cited works.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized prose edits, standardizes model names and expands explanations while retaining the main section sequence. Appendices are reorganized from A.1–A.5 into A–G, and the Limitations section is replaced by an Impact Statement.

P2.justification: v2 substantially reformats the document and appendix layout, adds the three-panel activation figure, replaces the hardware plot, and introduces multiple Qwen, MMMU and 4/8/4 tables. Llama-2 summary results move into the expanded appendix table, and the retained activation-distribution panels are rearranged horizontally.

improvement.justification: Evaluation beyond Llama, including MMMU, strengthens evidence of applicability, while decoder-block timings with an INT4 control address practical overhead more directly than v1's layer timings. These gains support a limited overall improvement, tempered by the removal of substantive limitations, inconsistent revised quantization equations and the unexplained 4/8/4 result discrepancy.
